name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  check-version-consistency:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Dart
        uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@v1
        with:
          sdk: stable

      - name: Verify version consistency
        run: |
          # Extract versions from pubspec.yaml files
          MCP_VERSION=$(grep '^version:' packages/marionette_mcp/pubspec.yaml | awk '{print $2}')
          FLUTTER_VERSION=$(grep '^version:' packages/marionette_flutter/pubspec.yaml | awk '{print $2}')
          
          echo "marionette_mcp version: $MCP_VERSION"
          echo "marionette_flutter version: $FLUTTER_VERSION"
          
          if [ "$MCP_VERSION" != "$FLUTTER_VERSION" ]; then
            echo "Error: Version mismatch between marionette_mcp ($MCP_VERSION) and marionette_flutter ($FLUTTER_VERSION)"
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Generate version.g.dart
        run: |
          VERSION=$(grep '^version:' packages/marionette_mcp/pubspec.yaml | awk '{print $2}')
          cat > packages/marionette_mcp/lib/src/version.g.dart << EOF
          // Generated file. Do not edit.
          const String marionetteMcpVersion = '$VERSION';
          EOF

      - name: Check if version.g.dart is up to date
        run: |
          if ! git diff --quiet packages/marionette_mcp/lib/src/version.g.dart; then
            echo "Error: version.g.dart is out of date. Please run the version generation script locally."
            git diff packages/marionette_mcp/lib/src/version.g.dart
            exit 1
          fi

  analyze:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: check-version-consistency
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Dart
        uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@v1
        with:
          sdk: stable

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          cd packages/marionette_mcp
          dart pub get
          cd ../marionette_flutter
          dart pub get

      - name: Run static analysis
        run: |
          cd packages/marionette_mcp
          dart analyze
          cd ../marionette_flutter
          dart analyze

  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: check-version-consistency
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Dart
        uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@v1
        with:
          sdk: stable

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          cd packages/marionette_mcp
          dart pub get
          cd ../marionette_flutter
          dart pub get

      - name: Run tests
        run: |
          cd packages/marionette_mcp
          dart test
          cd ../marionette_flutter
          dart test

  security-check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    needs: check-version-consistency
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Dart
        uses: dart-lang/setup-dart@v1
        with:
          sdk: stable

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          cd packages/marionette_mcp
          dart pub get
          cd ../marionette_flutter
          dart pub get

      - name: Run security audit
        run: |
          cd packages/marionette_mcp
          dart pub outdated --no-dev-dependencies
          cd ../marionette_flutter
          dart pub outdated --no-dev-dependencies
